findings.statement: The authority ceiling is not fail-closed enough for a copy-verbatim external request. The sentence that a proposal requires one new owner decision before repository edit, W7 computation, or scientific execution groups distinct authority layers and can be read as making one decision sufficient for W7. The unconstrained requested next-owner decision and an undefined reviewer PASS also permit the proposing auditor to appear to self-certify design readiness. D-039 instead permits this report to inform at most a later fresh design-only-review choice; W7 still requires an intervening unanimous whole-design PASS and a separate later owner decision, and B3 requires executed W7 evidence, fresh adjudication PASS, and another decision.
assumptions_used: Safety-critical authority text must state both necessary and insufficient conditions explicitly.
The external auditor may not grade its own candidate as a design-gate PASS.
counterevidence_refs: The prompt repeatedly says STOP/PRESERVE remains binding and that the audit grants no authority.

findings.statement: The candidate/output contract asks for a finite obligation matrix, structural novelty, falsifiers, cost, and stop-loss, but does not make completeness or novelty mechanically falsifiable. It requires no closed-world coverage count or zero-unmapped predicate over the seven D-037 failures, four retained passes, binding gates, consumers, operations, and evidence; narrative comparison can therefore claim completeness. It also leaves the read-only audit blocker-movement ratio open and uses the hype-prone route label BREAKTHROUGH_CANDIDATE_PROPOSED, allowing forecast evidence gain to be reported as achieved gate movement.
assumptions_used: Complete means complete relative to an explicitly frozen finite universe with no unmapped binding item.
A read-only proposal changes no scientific gate, so achieved blocker movement is 0.00 even if future movement is forecast.
